title: UI Reviewer prompt: relocate Playwright script to node_modules-resolvable directory (bug #3)
definition_of_done: reference-impl/prompts/ui-reviewer.md no longer writes the Playwright script to /tmp/; the script file is placed in a directory co-located with the worktree or reference-impl/ where node_modules/playwright is resolvable by Node
Changes pass the existing reference-impl test suite
acceptance_criteria: grep -n '/tmp/' reference-impl/prompts/ui-reviewer.md returns no matches for the Playwright script path (reproduces bug #3)

The updated prompt instructs placement of the script file in a directory where node_modules/playwright is present (e.g., inside the worktree root or reference-impl/) so Node module resolution succeeds
A manual review of the prompt confirms the script invocation uses a path within the worktree rather than /tmp/
